Table "public"."access_logs" {
  "access_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "data_id" INTEGER
  "access_date" TEXT
  "access_type" TEXT
  "access_status" TEXT
}

Table "public"."cabins" {
  "cabin_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "cabin_number" TEXT
  "deck" TEXT
  "cabin_type" TEXT
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "cabin_location" TEXT
  "cabin_size" REAL
  "cabin_amenities" TEXT
}

Table "public"."crew" {
  "crew_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "name" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "age" INTEGER
  "sex" INTEGER
  "embarked" TEXT
  "disembarked" TEXT
  "crew_position" TEXT
  "crew_department" TEXT
}

Table "public"."disembarkation_dates" {
  "disembarkation_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "port_id" INTEGER
  "disembarkation_date" TEXT
  "disembarkation_time" TEXT
}

Table "public"."documents" {
  "document_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "document_title" TEXT
  "document_type" TEXT
  "file_path" TEXT
  "upload_date" TEXT
  "document_format" TEXT
  "document_size" REAL
}

Table "public"."embarkation_dates" {
  "embarkation_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "port_id" INTEGER
  "embarkation_date" TEXT
  "embarkation_time" TEXT
}

Table "public"."families" {
  "family_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "head_of_family_id" INTEGER
  "family_size" INTEGER
  "relation_type" TEXT
  "family_income" REAL
  "family_ occupation" TEXT
}

Table "public"."fares" {
  "fare_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "fare_amount" REAL
  "discount" REAL
  "surcharge" REAL
  "payment_method" TEXT
  "payment_date" TEXT
  "payment_status" TEXT
}

Table "public"."medical_records" {
  "record_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "medical_conditions" TEXT
  "treatment_received" TEXT
  "onboard_treatment" TEXT
  "medical_history" TEXT
  "allergies" TEXT
  "medications" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passenger_cabins" {
  "pc_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "cabin_id" INTEGER
  "cabin_number" TEXT
  "cabin_deck" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passenger_documents" {
  "pd_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "document_id" INTEGER
  "document_type" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passenger_fares" {
  "pf_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "fare_id" INTEGER
  "fare_amount" REAL
  "fare_currency" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passenger_ports" {
  "passenger_port_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "embarkation_id" INTEGER
  "disembarkation_id" INTEGER
  "port_code" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passenger_survival_factors" {
  "psf_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "factor_id" INTEGER
  "factor_value" TEXT
  "factor_unit" TEXT
}

Table "public"."passengers" {
  "passenger_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "pclass" INTEGER
  "sex" INTEGER
  "age" REAL
  "fare" REAL
  "family_cnt" INTEGER
  "cabin_ind" INTEGER
  "survived" INTEGER
  "embarked" TEXT
  "disembarked" TEXT
  "medical_conditions" TEXT
  "height" REAL
  "weight" REAL
  "hair_color" TEXT
  "eye_color" TEXT
  "nationality" TEXT
  "occupation" TEXT
  "destination" TEXT
}

Table "public"."ports" {
  "port_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "port_name" TEXT
  "location" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
  "port_code" TEXT
  "port_type" TEXT
}

Table "public"."ship_info" {
  "ship_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "ship_name" TEXT
  "ship_type" TEXT
  "ship_length" REAL
  "ship_beam" REAL
  "ship_draft" REAL
  "ship_gross_tonnage" REAL
  "ship_speed" REAL
  "ship_capacity" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."survival_analysis" {
  "analysis_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "factor_id" INTEGER
  "survival_rate" REAL
  "sample_size" INTEGER
  "analysis_date" TEXT
  "confidence_interval" REAL
}

Table "public"."survival_factors" {
  "factor_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "factor_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "factor_type" TEXT
}

Table "public"."survivor_accounts" {
  "account_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "passenger_id" INTEGER
  "account_text" TEXT
  "interview_date" TEXT
  "interviewer" TEXT
  "account_type" TEXT
}

Table "public"."users" {
  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "password" TEXT
  "last_login" TEXT
}

Table "public"."voyage_info" {
  "voyage_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "ship_id" INTEGER
  "departure_date" TEXT
  "arrival_date" TEXT
  "departure_port" TEXT
  "arrival_port" TEXT
  "voyage_distance" REAL
  "voyage_duration" REAL
}
